title: Fairly Optimized
description: Fairly Optimized boosts your Minecraft speed and quality to give you the best possible lagless gaming experience.
body:
# **Fairly Optimized**

With over 40 different mods **Fairly Optimized** is a lightweight, pure-performance modpack designed to dramatically boost your frames per second (FPS), eliminate stuttering, and optimize your game's memory usage. Built entirely around cutting-edge performance mods, this pack keeps your gameplay completely vanilla while unlocking the full processing potential of any computer—from low-end laptops to high-end streaming rigs.

## **Key Features**
Speedy Performance: Say goodbye to stuttering and low frames. By swapping out inefficient vanilla rendering routines for modern, highly optimized engines, Fairly Optimized can significantly increase your FPS while reducing CPU and RAM strain.

Pure Vanilla Compatibility: Fairly Optimized contains no content mods. It does not introduce new blocks, items, or biomes. This means you can connect to any vanilla server, SMP, or public multiplayer network without a hitch.

Lightweight & Fast Load Times: Every mod has been meticulously selected and tested to ensure stability, fast game startup times, and seamless world loading.

Built on [Fabric]: Utilizing a modern, lightweight mod loader ensures the pack runs with minimal overhead, leaving more system resources dedicated to rendering your game smoothly.

## **Details**
Fairly Optimized achieves its massive performance gains by targeting every bottleneck in the Minecraft engine:

Graphics & Rendering Engine: Powered by industry-standard optimization mods that rewrite the chunk rendering pipeline for massive FPS gains.

Logic & Physics Optimization: Improves server-side and single-player internal math, streamlining entity logic, collisions, and chunk loading without changing how the game feels.

Memory & Bug Fixes: Reduces overall RAM footprint and fixes underlying engine bugs and memory leaks to prevent game crashes during extended play sessions.

Smooth Micro-Optimizations: Optimizes fast quitting, entity culling (not rendering things you can't see), and rapid language switching.

## **❓ FAQ**
Q: Do I need to install this on my server?
A: No! Fairly Optimized is a strictly client-side modpack. You can use it to play on any single-player world or join any multiplayer server.

Q: Can I add my own mods to this pack?
A: Absolutely. Fairly Optimized makes a perfect, clean foundation for your custom setups. Feel free to add your favorite UI mods, maps, or content mods on top of it.

Q: How much RAM should I allocate?
A: Because this pack is highly optimized, it runs perfectly on just 2GB to 4GB of allocated RAM, making it ideal for lower-spec hardware.
